value.evidence: Draft A preserves concrete failure modes (Gemma missing 2/4 list items, Qwen confusing 10^9 vs 109) and names specific model variants (Gemma 2b/7b/27b/3 4B Instruct QAT, Qwen-2.5-vl-7b), enabling community members to recognize whether they've tested the same models. It explicitly flags missing context (hardware, document quality, model versions) and source date (May 2025), maintaining credibility boundaries. The closing question directly invites tradeoff discussion relevant to local LLM work. Draft B abstracts away identifying details ('a set of Google's models,' 'another 7B parameter vision-language model,' 'numerical expressions like exponentiation versus concatenation'), reducing specificity and making it harder for readers to assess relevance to their own setups or contribute targeted experience. While B is more concise, it sacrifices the concrete anchors that make A actionable for the stated audience. Both avoid forbidden claims, but A's precision and uncertainty acknowledgment better serve community_fit and usefulness for local LLM enthusiasts seeking reproducible comparisons.
